description: Chat with your documents: a clean RAG interface for any model.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-11: a real install of Kotaemon 0.12.0 (the release-day main-lite build) proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. Local Store wrote this definition from the project's own deployment instructions.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Written by Local Store from the project's own deployment instructions, not taken from an app store.
Starts with one account, username admin and password admin; change it the first time you sign in.
Uses the model you configure — a provider's API key or a local Ollama — and indexes the documents you upload into its folder.
Kotaemon publishes 0.12.0 only as its rolling main-lite tag; the install pins the build from its release day, 2026-05-31, by digest.
Its image is 15.9 GB — the largest Local Store offers — so the first install downloads that much and needs that much free disk.
